body:
This PR adds the necessary functionality to support ClimaAtmos simulation of multiple columns. This includes allowing the user to pass the `deep` keyword argument to `Grids.ExtrudedFiniteDifferenceGrid` when using the convenience constructor for a multiple column grid/space and missing functionality for `MultiPointSpace` that ClimaAtmos need.

In addition, the metric of a `MultiPointSpace` was changed to be the identity matrix which is consist with a `PointSpace`.
title: Change metric of multiple column grid to identity matrix

body:
`mul_return_type` promoted the element type of a `Number * Tensor` product but kept the storage type, giving a type such as `Tensor{1, Dual, B, SVector{1, Float64}}` that `*` cannot produces. Conversions read `parent(v)`, so under inference the product came out `Float`; a broadcast that had to be materialized into an intermediate allocated the intermediate as `Float` and did not write `Dual` values. This blocked ClimaAtmos's Smagorinsky–Lilly closure under the autodiff Jacobians.

The storage type is now promoted with `similar_type`, preserving the `Adjoint` structure of covectors. Unpromoted cases are unchanged. 

This also adds unit tests and a column-level regression test.
title: Promote the storage type in `Number * Tensor` return types
